**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2021/06/01 (Tue) 05:55
- [USER] User inquired about publishing an infographic with text on Twitter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Twitter recommends that infographics with text be no larger than 1024x512 pixels to ensure they are easily readable on all devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Twitter has a file size limit of 5MB for images.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is important to balance resolution and file size to achieve good quality of the image while being able to share it.
